description: THE RECOMMENDATION LEDGER - one row per recommendation a dated project report made, with what became of it: open, taken (the record section or PR) or declined (whose decision). Kept by src/analyse/report_recs.py: --sync pulls the newest report's rows in, /onboard lists the open ones, /handoff marks the taken ones, and the next report's audit reads this file instead of re-deriving it (DECISIONS.md 9.171). The first ten reports' rows live in the reports' own audits; the ledger starts at the tenth.

rows.what: Make the viewer's reading safe in the harness process: report_mode_ridership.report() returns its rows (no module-global LAST), the viewer computes at most one reading at a time and never redirects sys.stdout - or runs the reporter as a subprocess with --json.
rows.evidence: 9.170: the viewer runs the reporter as a subprocess

rows.what: Land arm 0's findings in results/processed: re-run results_store.process('20260912T202242_300it_25pct', extract=True) under the bounded reader and log it; then make the close-out refuse to mark a run processed while _metrics.json / _fit.json are absent from processed/.
rows.evidence: 9.170: arm 0's _fit.json and _metrics.json extracted to processed/; session_gate --handoff checks every completed run

rows.what: Read arm 0 at its horizon and spend the routers pair first (C.raptor.mode_cost_representation = mode_constant against absent), 250 iterations at 25 %, coverage read on both sides, then scoring -> choice set -> service quality -> submodes.

Rebuild the demand so that ride is seeded at the HTS share (B.mode.bound_passenger_placement) and the short end of destination placement has an observed shape - one rebuild, one family, then re-baseline.
Require the nine test-workflow jobs as status checks in the main ruleset (ruleset 21121872) - the prepared JSON is in the session's scratch directory; the agent's API call was refused by the harness.

Retype the six hidden copies of registry values the scanners cannot see: B.population.home_jitter_radius_factor (* 0.6 at build_activity_chains.py:2416, :2789, :2872) and the four corridor VEHICLE/DWELL_DEFAULTS values (build_corridor_layers.py:117-135, :151); make check_hardcoding visit the value of ALL-CAPS assignments and dict(...) keywords.
rows.evidence: 9.170: six typed twins read from the registry

rows.what: Consume B.population.household_size_top_band_mean (size the 6+ band from its mean) at the next demand rebuild, or retire it now with a record entry.
Add refuse_concurrent_arm() to preflight() so --detach refuses a second arm before scheduling, not only in the detached log; name the scheduled task by the run stamp so --stop finds it.
rows.evidence: 9.170: refuse_concurrent_arm() at preflight; the detached run and its task share one stamp

rows.what: Price the pair arms on arm 0's innovating/tail split (199 x 351 s + 49 x 262 s + dumps) instead of one plain median, and write plans every 50 on the pair overlays.
Make the gate watcher's give-up visible: when a milestone's reporter fails twice, write a verdict file saying 'unread' and print it, and let session_gate report a run whose readings ledger has a gap.
rows.evidence: 9.170: the gate watcher writes an unread verdict when the reporter fails

rows.what: Resolve a run's residents through the run's own population (output_persons.csv.gz), not the city's current B1 table.
Send the TfNSW bespoke-table request (mode x age, trip-length distribution by mode, occupancy by purpose, the unfolded Other).
Measure the replication band: three short arms at different seeds, then set CAL.objective.replication_band_pp.
Put a licence line on the published reports and the Pages site footer, and retire the reports' per-run detail that repeats the library.
Move the two document rule files to docs/tests/ (or config/) and pin the brief's and the position pages' live counts in doc_currency.
rows.evidence: 9.171: doc_shape.json is the framework's at tests/; the brief's counts are pinned (#203 #207)

rows.what: Retire closed-family gate readings from the position pages' 'What is measured' (F17-F31 rows) into their History lines, and cap a page by bytes as well as lines.
rows.evidence: 9.171: positions capped at 14,000 bytes and 600 chars a line; closed-family readings retired to History (#205)

rows.what: Record the build's wall time everywhere: wrap build_matsim_run_inputs.py, build_manifest.py, the extract adapters and the pt2matsim mapping in build_timing, and have collect_performance.py read _build_timing.json.
Hoist the three per-iteration thread pools (RemodeRestore.route x2, routeDetoursInParallel) to one pool per run, keeping one TripRouter per worker so the RNG sequence is unchanged.
Give the taxi fleet its sample fraction from RUN.sample.fraction, not qsim.flowCapFactor.
The eleventh report runs after the next reading - a pair arm's gate or horizon - and not before.
